title: Phase 1: single-sandbox cloud run
description: The trojan horse (needs planning when foundations close): tk cloud run <epic> starts a Run Workflow that boots ONE orchestrator sandbox (omp kind, harness substrate for workers inside it), clones at the submitted SHA, runs the existing skill loop, pushes branches, parks gates in the RunRoom DO, delivers them via Telegram, enforces budget from AI Gateway. Zero new orchestration logic — proves auth, secrets, git credentials, sandbox lifecycle, budgets, and phone gates end to end. Includes RunRoom DO lease + pending store and the D1 signals/dispatch_log schema (D20).
notes: 2026-08-19 15:30 - [human] Scope expanded 2026-08-19 by human decision: terminal rung of the UC1b operator command surface (D21/D22) is Phase 1. See docs/design/cloud-factory.md UC1b.
acceptance_criteria: A pushed epic submitted with tk cloud run completes end to end in one cloud orchestrator sandbox with the laptop closed: branches and a PR appear on the remote, gates reach Telegram and can be answered from a phone, the run cost in the runs row comes from AI Gateway telemetry, tk cloud status reports it live, tk cloud stop produces a clean stop with review and closeout still run, a killed sandbox is replaced and the run still finishes, and a second submission on the same project refuses naming the lease holder.
